items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Inventory - Update Repair
items.description: Update Repair helps admins identify Windows devices with Microsoft 365 Apps that are out of date or experiencing update issues. In the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center, admins can review device status and recommended actions, remotely start Online Repair for eligible devices, and follow manual remediation guidance for devices that need attention. Repair reinstalls Microsoft 365 Apps using the latest available build for the device’s configured update channel.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Add alternate text to images shared from OneDrive and SharePoint
items.description: Improve accessibility by adding alternate text to images shared in Teams from OneDrive and SharePoint, helping users better understand visual content

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC High and DoD
items.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription choices align with admin policies
items.description: Meeting organizers will only see automatic recording and transcription choices in Meeting Options that are allowed by their organization's existing meeting policies. A new Record only choice lets organizers automatically start recording without starting transcription. Depending on the organizer's policies, available choices can include Record and transcribe, Transcribe only, Record only, and Off. When both recording and transcription are disabled by policy, the automatic setting is not shown.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Message or an External User for Security Concern in Gov Clouds
items.description: Users in Gov clouds can now report suspicious messages and external users within Teams. Reports are surfaced in the Teams admin center, giving admins greater visibility into potentially malicious activity and enabling them to investigate and take appropriate action. By incorporating end-user reports as an additional security signal, this capability helps organizations identify and respond more quickly to phishing, impersonation, spam, and other messaging threats.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Delegated prompt publishing for organization prompts
items.description: This release follows the availability of organization prompts, providing admins the ability to upload custom prompts for their organization in the Copilot app home screen. Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups. These delegated users and groups will be able to create, edit and delete organization prompts at the tenant level through the Prompt Lab, without having to access the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. Admins can continue t

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions audit log improvements
items.description: Improving permission checks when users access the Microsoft Purview portal. Enhanced audit logs will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out calls into a new browser window
items.description: Microsoft Teams browser app users will be able to pop out calls into a simplified call window that stays available while they navigate away from, hide, or minimize the tab or progressive web app (PWA) hosting the call. This helps users multitask and collaborate more easily during calls.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: New sharing panel in meetings - improved content discovery and ease of sharing
items.description: The sharing panel in today’s meetings is the default place for content discoverability and sharing.  New sharing panel UI is crafted with intent of modernising and simplifying default tasks such as window sharing, but also for easier discovery of sharing options and more discoverable file sharing.

items.title: Power Automate: Direct triggers for desktop flows
items.description: Desktop flows will support direct triggers, enabling automations to start in response to supported events without requiring an intermediary cloud flow. This simplifies automation design and reduces the effort required to connect desktop flows to business processes.

items.title: Power Automate: Credentials - Integration with Delinea secret server
items.description: Power Automate will support Delinea Secret Server as an external credential provider for desktop flows. Organizations can securely use credentials managed in Delinea for machine sign-in and credential retrieval during attended and unattended automation.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Send each message only once with deduplication for SMS and custom channels
items.description:
Deduplicates recipients by contact point, so each phone number or custom channel address gets the message once per send.
Eliminates manual post-send clean-up, wasted messaging spend and the customer annoyance of duplicate texts.
Brings SMS and custom channels to parity with email's built-in deduplication.

items.description: Adding easy access to top sites in Edge search bar on desktop. Users can add, edit, remove, or hide top sites. Admins can control available to this feature using the NewTabPageManagedQuickLinks and NewTabPageQuickLinksEnabled policies.

items.description: The write to business rules engine configuration experience introduces an option to submit only records that have successfully passed Account structure validation. Records that have not passed validation are excluded from the submission so users can review and correct them before attempting to write them

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Build audiences faster with reusable segment templates
items.description: Segment templates help you build audiences without recreating queries for each campaign. Choose a built-in template for common scenarios such as event attendance or email engagement, or save your own segment query as a reusable custom template. Add placeholders with hint text to guide marketers through entering campaign-specific values, reducing repetitive setup while keeping audience criteria consistent.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Microsoft Learning Zone - Minecraft connected lessons
items.description:
Bring Minecraft Education to every classroom with AI-powered tools that match curriculum goals to Build Challenges, blend lessons with project-based learning, launch directly from Learning Zone, and give you full visibility into participation, completion, and student understanding.
#education

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Cross-Tenant Orchestrated Migration
items.description: Cross-Tenant Orchestrated Migration for User Data Migration (UDM) and Shared Data Migration (SDM) allows customers to move their Microsoft 365 data from one Microsoft tenant to another. UDM includes the ability to move user mailboxes, OneDrive accounts, Teams chats, and Teams meetings. SDM includes the ability to move M365 Groups, SharePoint Sites, Group Mailboxes, and teams and channels.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Archive project cost actuals with long-term retention
items.description:
Organizations managing high volumes of project transactions need to retain historical cost data without allowing years of completed transactions to continually increase the volume of active operational data. This capability enables organizations to archive processed project staging table cost actuals for long-term retention while preserving access to historical records when needed.

Administrators can archive eligible project cost actuals for selected legal entities and date ranges using the Arc

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit your Copilot-generated PowerPoint presentation outline via Pages in Chat
items.description: You can now edit and collaborate on the presentation outline generated by Copilot in a Page before the PowerPoint deck is created.  This item is no longer accurate and is being removed from the roadmap.  We apologize for any inconvenience

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Allow to invoice future-dated transactions
items.description:
Available for core and integrated.
Currently, project invoices include transactions based on the invoice date, which can make it difficult to prepare invoices in advance when additional transactions are expected before the end of the billing period.
With this feature, you can use the Accounting date as the transaction cutoff date for an invoice. When the Accounting date is later than the invoice date, you can include eligible future-dated transactions through the Accounting date on the invoice.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Expanded enforcement controls for Data Loss Prevention connectors
items.description: Microsoft Edge for Business is expanding its existing Data Loss Prevention Enterprise Connector capabilities. Administrators will be able to configure more consistent enforcement across download, upload, paste, and print workflows. Additional controls include required bypass justification and administrator-defined guidance.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Tenant policy controls who can record and transcribe
items.description: Teams administrators can use meeting policies to control who can start recording and transcription, helping organizations apply consistent meeting settings. Administrators can restrict these permissions to organizers and co-organizers or extend them to presenters. They can also determine whether meeting organizers can modify these settings or whether they are enforced by policy.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Real-time queue metrics in the Queues app on Mobile
items.description: Calling representative and Supervisor leads can view real-time call queue metrics directly from the Queues app on Mobile, giving them greater visibility into current queue activity and performance while on the go. Users can quickly understand the state of their queues, monitor key operational metrics, and make more informed decisions about their availability and queue participation without needing to switch to desktop.

items.title: Outlook: More visibility into usage for recoverable items storage
items.description: You'll be able to see how much storage your recoverable items are using in Outlook. This gives you a clearer picture of your storage usage before you reach a limit. You can use this information to make more informed decisions about managing your mailbox. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Expand or collapse all accounts at once
items.description: You'll be able to expand or collapse all accounts at once in Outlook's folder pane. You won't need to expand or collapse each account individually. This makes it easier to navigate multiple accounts or keep your folder pane compact. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Remember your online archive folder pane state
items.description: Outlook will remember whether your online archive is expanded or collapsed when you return. Outlook on the web and the new Outlook for Windows will each keep their own saved state. This saves you from repeatedly expanding or collapsing your archive as you navigate your mailbox. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Keep folders expanded when you restart Outlook
items.description: Outlook will remember which folders and shared mailboxes you have expanded or collapsed when you restart the app. You can pick up where you left off without opening the same folder branches again. This makes returning to your usual folders easier. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Sort your subfolders from A to Z
items.description: You'll be able to sort a folder's subfolders alphabetically from the parent folder. This makes it easier to find the folder you need without rearranging subfolders one by one. It's a simple way to keep long folder lists organized. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Keep folder sharing within your organization's policies
items.description: Folder sharing in Outlook will respect your organization's restrictions for Default and Anonymous permissions. When these restrictions are enabled, you won't be able to change either setting. Permissions granted directly to individual users will remain unaffected. This helps keep folder sharing aligned with your organization's policies. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Quality Evaluation Agent - Review historical quality metrics in a unified dashboard
items.description: The quality evaluation historical dashboard provides aggregated insights from completed evaluations, helping organizations track quality trends over time. Users can view quality scores and trends across selected date ranges, with up to two years of historical data available.

items.title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Secure Dataverse record with column-based filtering
items.description: This enhancement introduces column-based security filtering, enabling records to be secured using attribute values rather than traditional ownership. This allows security admins to define access based on business dimensions such as region or department, making it ideal for scenarios where record ownership does not exist—such as reporting and aggregated datasets. By eliminating the need for artificial ownership or complex sharing models, this approach simplifies security administration, improves
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Design receipts using a modern, web-based designer in headquarters and print them on A4 paper or thermal printers from Store Commerce, supporting B2B scenarios
items.description:
Applies to: Point of Sale (Store Commerce app and web), Commerce headquarters receipt format designer, Hardware Station, and Commerce Scale Unit.
The modern receipt designer introduces a React-based designer in headquarters at Retail and Commerce > Channel setup > POS setup > POS > Receipt formats > Designer. Users can author receipts in the browser with live preview, without installing the legacy desktop designer host. The legacy designer remains available for existing formats.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: E-Documents - Self-billing enablement
items.description:
Streamline self-billing by automatically creating, managing, and exchanging electronic documents for self-billed invoices as part of the invoice lifecycle. This reduces manual document handling while helping ensure self-billed transactions include the appropriate electronic documents in standardized formats used by local regulations and trading partners.
Benefits
•	Automate electronic document generation and handling for self-billed invoices.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Cowork: Access Business Applications with Work IQ
items.description: Users can access Business Applications through Work IQ in Copilot Cowork and use Business Skills to complete end-to-end business processes grounded in their enterprise data and apps. This helps users move from finding the right business application to taking action across key workflows with less context switching.

items.title: Work IQ: Business Skills to manage your business processes in Work IQ MCP
items.description:
Business skills are natural-language instructions that capture how your organization gets work done. They represent your business processes, policies, and domain knowledge in a format that agents can understand and follow. Each skill describes how to complete a specific type of work—the steps involved, the information required, and the business rules that apply.
Agents discover and use the business skills they have access to as needed at runtime using Work IQ MCP to complete tasks according to y

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot People Connectors introduces people data ingestions with differentiated access control
items.description: Copilot People Connector now supports importing people data with access controls into Microsoft 365. This release enables organizations to bring people data from external systems into Microsoft 365 along with associated access control lists (ACLs), ensuring Copilot respects existing permissions defined in source systems. The imported data can be scoped to specific individuals and groups, allowing Copilot to reason over people data while honoring access restrictions.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
items.description: AI agent skill to detect and alert unhealthy policy sync and device configuration.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – New Guided Experience to Diagnose and Resolve DLP Issues
items.description:
We’re introducing a new guided diagnostics experience to help users understand why their DLP policies may not be behaving as expected. This experience provides a clear summary of why a DLP action was taken on a document, including which policies were triggered, the order of evaluation, and detailed insights into which conditions evaluated as true or false.
For Microsoft 365 E5 customers, the experience also includes Copilot-powered insights and tailored recommendations to accelerate troubleshoot

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Increase in expansion limit for auto expanding archive beyond 1.5TB
items.description: Previously, auto expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archive beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Copilot assisted commenting in Glint survey taking
items.description: Viva Glint survey takers will be able to use a streamlined version of Microsoft Copilot in the Glint survey taking experience to help them rewrite their comments, helping survey takers feel more confident about the feedback they’re providing. By increasing perceived security through reducing identifiable writing patterns and minimizing the effort required to refine feedback, this experience can encourage greater participation, longer responses, and more candid comments, which can drive higher en

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: When a Teams Rooms on Windows acts as an organizer, co-organizer or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group.  You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: OneNote: Copilot Notebooks available in OneNote on Web
items.description: Users will now have access to their Copilot Notebooks on the web version of OneNote.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users will be able to upload files stored locally or in one drive to custom engine agents
items.description: Users will be able to upload files stored locally or in one drive to custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Add Search results as references to your Copilot Notebooks in the M365 Copilot app
items.description: Users can quickly add a Search result as a reference to a Copilot Notebook within the M365 Copilot app.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in SharePoint
items.description: Simplifies SharePoint content management and ensures content is Copilot-ready by automating metadata, fixing stale content, enabling fast page creation, improving compliance, and enriching content so Copilot can deliver more accurate, grounded answers. Updated April 16: We are still in development for GA and have launched to Preview only.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent recap for DoD
items.description: Intelligent meeting recap uses AI to provide a quick summary of your meeting, highlighting key discussion points, identifying follow-up actions, and offering quick access to significant points such as name mentions, when a screen was shared, individualized speaker markers, topics, and chapters.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention – Restrict access action support for sematic models and lakehouses in Fabric
items.description: Your organization can now control who can access your data depending on the sensitive information detected in Fabric semantic models and lakehouses. DLP restrict access action allows you to block access to guest users or all users depending on what labels or sensitive information types matches your semantic models or lakehouses. This is in addition to the ability already supported by DLP policies to audit and notify users via Policy Tips based on sensitive content within Fabric semantic models a

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
items.description: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Rewrite is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge. Updated March 20, 2026: We have paused release of this feature temporarily and will announce new release timelines soon. We apologize for any

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings
items.description: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings gives organizations greater control over access to sensitive meetings. Administrators can apply Conditional Access policies to selected meetings, helping ensure participants meet organizational security requirements before joining.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM-Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
items.description:
We’re introducing the new readiness for Microsoft Copilot and data explorer experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). These new capabilities provide data security teams with greater visibility into their organization’s data security posture and help them assess risks, investigate findings, and prioritize remediation.
The readiness for Microsoft Copilot experience in Purview DSPM helps organizations assess and improve their data readiness for Microsoft Copilot. It

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling scalability, policy management, and reporting enhancements
items.description: Microsoft Purview is improving auto-labeling capabilities to help organizations manage and validate labeling policies at enterprise scale. These enhancements expand support for larger SharePoint scopes, improve policy management flexibility, and provide richer visibility into auto-labeling activity.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Federated Copilot connectors enable users to securely connect Microsoft Copilot to their favorite third party sources, retrieving data in real-time using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Federated Copilot connectors do not store or index customer data in Microsoft - access happens in real time using the user’s own identity, while administrators retain full governance and control through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. With GA, federated Copilot connectors will be supported across Researcher age

items.title: SharePoint: HTML pages
items.description: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload your own HTML from another source. Once stored in the pages library, you can render HTML as a page in SharePoint, make additional edits, and share with your audience. HTML gives you new ways to present your content beautifully alongside our existing ASPX pages.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report
items.description: For each enforced auto-labeling policy, admins can view how files processed during enforcement correlate to the latest simulation run. The per-policy coverage report shows volumes of files that have been labeled or are not yet labeled, and whether those files were included in the last simulation snapshot. This helps admins understand enforcement progress for a specific policy against the data state captured during simulation, while also identifying files that were not found in the simulation sna

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Additional health signals available for Teams Rooms on Android on Pro Management Portal
items.description: Expanded Pro Management Portal (PMP) health monitoring for Teams Rooms on Android by surfacing device health signals including storage health, Teams meeting app, calendar sync, secondary display health and network. When issues are detected, PMP will automatically generate actionable alerts and support ticket creation workflows, enabling IT administrators to proactively identify and triage room health issues before they impact meeting experiences.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: See more messages on mobile
items.description: We are introducing a more streamlined messaging experience that displays more content on screen while improving readability when using Teams on mobile. These updates make it easier to scan conversations and follow the discussion flow, helping users stay productive and engaged wherever they work.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
items.description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the Copilot new tab page. Users will see upgraded Copilot new tab page functionality and features.

items.title: Outlook: Block External Images Settings Update
items.description: Outlook on the web and the new Outlook for Windows now support will support new settings for loading external images. New settings will allow customers to block all external content, or to load all content by default if the customer admin allows. Existing default behavior will not be changed (load external content only for safe senders).

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
items.description: AI-powered visibility into DLP policy deployment across devices, helping admins track sync progress and understand enforcement coverage. They proactively identify impacted devices, explain root causes of sync failures, and guide admins with recommended actions to quickly diagnose and resolve issues.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): MCP-Based Agent Enablement for U.S. Government Clouds
items.description: We’re introducing support for Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot . This update enables developers to build Copilot agents using MCP servers and allows users to interact with these agents using familiar experiences. This change supports extensibility and improves agent capabilities for organizations.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Preloaded video for Teams Events and Meetings
items.description: Users can now upload videos directly into a Teams event or meeting from OneDrive from the "Manage view" options when an organizer has turned on Manage What Attendees See mode. This ensures a smoother high quality video playback with a more consistent experience for attendees.

items.title: Power Apps: New view layout in model-driven apps
items.description:
Makers can now choose to display their data as a calendar or a stack of cards instead of the default grid layout. Makers can configure these layouts directly in the model driven app designer, giving users more intuitive ways to visualize and work with their data.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Export Improvements
items.description: New export improvements are coming to Cloud Update, making it easier for organizations to access and analyze device data. These enhancements will expand export capabilities across Inventory and Cloud Update device views, include additional device and update information, and allow admins to export filtered results so they can focus on the devices most relevant to their needs.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enable semantic model in Sales agent
items.description:
Semantic model helps Sales Agent understand the structure and meaning of an organization’s CRM data. It creates a connected representation of CRM metadata, including tables or objects, fields, descriptions, data types, relationships, views, pick-list values, and glossary terms. Sales Agent can retrieve this context when responding to questions, improving its ability to interpret business language and answer complex questions that span related CRM records.
Dynamics 365 admins can enable and turn

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-View-only access to device onboarding with the View-Only Device Management role
items.description:
Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is introducing more granular, role-based access to the Devices page under Settings → Device Onboarding. Previously, viewing or managing device onboarding required broad administrative roles (such as Compliance Administrator, Global Administrator, or Security Administrator). With this update, organizations can grant access using least-privilege Purview role-based access control (RBAC) roles scoped specifically to device operations.
A new View-Only Device Man

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Enable project resources on general journal entries
items.description:
This feature expands the existing general journal functionality for modern projects.
A new capability is added so general journal lines can have an associated project resource.

Specifying the project resource on a journal line allows for increased tracking and auditability for where organizations want to track expense journals on a detailed per-resource basis instead of in a summary.
Tracking expenses on a per-resource basis is especially helpful for scenarios around accruals where all expenses

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Loop meeting notes stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive
items.description: For non-channel Microsoft Teams meetings, collaborative meeting notes, including Loop-powered meeting notes and Facilitator notes, will be stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive for Business instead of the OneDrive of the person who starts the notes. This update provides more consistent ownership and management of meeting content while preserving the existing note-taking and collaboration experience for meeting participants.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Phishing Detection in Teams Messaging
items.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing AI-powered phishing detection that uses conversation context to identify phishing and social engineering in higher-risk messaging scenarios, primarily external first-contact chats. Additional protection may apply in certain regions or scenarios. The capability is used only for security protection, and users may see warnings when suspicious activity is detected.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
items.description: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. In this mode you can create, rename, and delete pages, sections, or notebooks as well as add or edit content in pages. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.

items.title: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
items.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.157 - Updated performance information in tab hover cards
items.description: Microsoft Edge is updating tab hover cards to provide clearer information about tab memory usage and memory savings when inactive tabs are discarded. Users will also have separate settings for tab-preview images and memory-usage information.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.
